title: Gravity Hub
desc: 1. Gravity Hub Script [Official] – No Key, Auto Farm, Auto Candy, Auto V4, Bring Fruits
code:
-- Blox Fruits Fly by RBX Hub
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
local hum = char.Humanoid
hum.WalkSpeed = 30
local flying, flyBV = false, nil
local function StartFly()
    flying = true
    local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
    flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
    flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
    RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying then return end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local dir = Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir+=cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir-=cam.CFrame.LookVector end
        flyBV.Velocity = dir * 80
        bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
    end)
end
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.F then
        if flying then flying=false; flyBV:Destroy() else StartFly() end
    end
end)
print("[RBX Hub] F = Fly Toggle")

title: Auto Farm Coins
desc: Auto kumpulin koin & diamond otomatis tanpa harus klik manual.
code:
-- Pet Sim X Auto Farm by RBX Hub
local hrp = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
local farming = true
task.spawn(function()
    while farming do
        for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name:find("Coin") then
                hrp.CFrame = v:GetPivot()
                task.wait(0.08)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
print("[RBX Hub] Auto Farm Aktif!")

title: Inf Jump + Noclip
desc: Infinite jump dan noclip. Tekan N untuk aktifkan noclip kapan aja!
code:
-- Brookhaven Utility by RBX Hub
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local char = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
local hum = char.Humanoid
local noclip = false
UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
end)
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.N then noclip = not noclip end
end)
RS.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if noclip then
        for _,v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide=false end
        end
    end
end)
print("[RBX Hub] Inf Jump aktif | N = Noclip")
